Methodology

HOW THE WEALTH MAP WORKS.

A dated estimate, a transparent source trail and a permanent distinction between wealth, income, ownership and inference.

Ranking baseline

The first release uses the Forbes 2026 annual list, based on stock prices and exchange rates from 1 March 2026. Later estimates must never overwrite the historical baseline.

Public shares

Public holdings should be valued using a dated share price and a sourced ownership quantity. Options, pledged shares and debt require separate treatment.

Private companies

Private-company estimates require a transparent valuation method, comparable transactions or reliable reporting. Ranges are preferred to false precision.

Income

Salary, dividends, share sales and business distributions must be separated from unrealised changes in estimated net worth.

Families and trusts

Family wealth is attributed only according to the source methodology and public records. A trust or foundation connection is not treated as personal liquid ownership without evidence.

Corrections

Every correction should preserve the previous figure, new figure, source date, evidence level and reason for change.

Boundary: A relationship, investment, jurisdiction, donation or contract does not by itself establish wrongdoing, control or coordinated intent.
